question: What is the main goal of rehabilitating a deteriorated sanitary sewer?
correctAnswer: To restore its structural condition and reduce leakage and infiltration
explanation: Rehabilitation renews a deteriorated pipe so it is structurally sound and watertight, which cuts infiltration and extends service life.
options: To increase the diameter of every sewer on the street
To restore its structural condition and reduce leakage and infiltration
To remove manholes from the collection system
To stop all flow monitoring in that basin
optionA: To increase the diameter of every sewer on the street
optionB: To restore its structural condition and reduce leakage and infiltration
optionC: To remove manholes from the collection system
optionD: To stop all flow monitoring in that basin
sourceTitle: US EPA — CMOM Guide for Sanitary Sewer Collection Systems

question: Cured in place pipe lining is best described as which method?
correctAnswer: A liner installed inside the existing pipe and cured to form a new pipe within the old pipe
explanation: Cured in place lining is a trenchless renewal method where a resin liner is installed in the host pipe and cured in position.
options: An open cut method that removes and replaces the whole pipe
A spray coating used only on manhole benches
A liner installed inside the existing pipe and cured to form a new pipe within the old pipe
A chemical dosed into flow to control odour
optionA: An open cut method that removes and replaces the whole pipe
optionB: A spray coating used only on manhole benches
optionC: A liner installed inside the existing pipe and cured to form a new pipe within the old pipe
optionD: A chemical dosed into flow to control odour

Sealed manholes eliminate the need for ventilation planning

question: What is the purpose of a renewal reserve fund in collection utility finance?
correctAnswer: To set funds aside over time for future renewal so large costs do not land in a single year
explanation: Reserves smooth the cost of predictable future renewal across the years that benefit, instead of spiking rates in one year.

To pay daily operating supplies only
To replace the need for a capital plan

question: A finance proposal sets next year renewal spending as last year spending plus inflation, with no reference to condition data. Why is that weak financial planning for a collection utility?
correctAnswer: Renewal spending should follow the condition and risk forecast from the asset plan, not a simple trend of past spending
explanation: Past spending reflects past choices, not future need; the asset plan forecast of condition and risk is what renewal funding should follow.
options: Renewal spending should follow the condition and risk forecast from the asset plan, not a simple trend of past spending
It is weak only because inflation was included at all
Past spending is always the correct forecast for renewal
Condition data has no place in any financial decision
optionA: Renewal spending should follow the condition and risk forecast from the asset plan, not a simple trend of past spending
optionB: It is weak only because inflation was included at all
optionC: Past spending is always the correct forecast for renewal
optionD: Condition data has no place in any financial decision
sourceTitle: US EPA — CMOM Guide for Sanitary Sewer Collection Systems
